name: Knolle
prior: Adaptive just intonation is a 20-year-old tool: Hermode Tuning in Logic Pro/Cubase (analyses fifths/thirds, retunes to pure sizes; VS: arxiv 1706.04338, periodicos.ufes.br), Kontakt 'Dynamic Pure Tuning' (VS), Pivotuner 2023 (VST3/AU MIDI effect, real-time adaptive pure intonation with an 'adaptive tuning center'; VS: arxiv 2306.03873), Stange/Wick/Hinrichsen 2017 (linear-equation dynamic JI; VS), alt-tuner (REAPER), Mutabor, LMSO Nuscale (VS: xen.wiki Adaptive JI), Schwär/Müller ISMIR 2021 (gradient-descent real-time intonation; VS), Hayward Tuning Vine NIME 2015 (VS), patents US 4248119 (chord detector → root → JI chord tones, 1981) and US 7807908 (VS: uspto). A sounding root that listens to chords is the Auto Bass Chord of every arranger keyboard since the Yamaha PSR-60 (1985, 'automatic bass chord function'; Casio auto accompaniment since 1979; VS: smemmusic.ch, wikipedia) – without JI or confidence swell. Dusk Audio Chord Analyzer detects root/bass from MIDI without sound (VS). Virtual pitch (Terhardt), SHS (Hermes), Parncutt's root model are analysis literature, not instruments (A). In-app: Nebel `sub`, Tiefe, inventor Gespinst, composer Mykorrhiza (V: ideas). Unoccupied after 3 searches (1 extended): a confidence-weighted sounding root organism (SHS over held voices and lanes) combined with an adaptive-JI pull in a touch instrument.

cost_detail.L1: per voice 2 OSC (PeriodicWave + sine) + LP + 2 Gain + ConstantSource v.ji ≈ 7 nodes ≈ 0.25–0.4 (Hauch 0.3 has a similar count; detune automation raises it) → 0.4 fair
cost_detail.singleton: A.knl: 2 OSC + LP + Gain ≈ 0.15–0.3 once while alive; not a Voice → never stolen → add to voiceLoad() permanently while alive (Q.cost is per voice, V code-map §5)
cost_detail.search: knlTick every 60 ms: 240–480 candidates × ≤ 12 voices ≈ 6k flops → negligible on the main thread
cost_detail.L3: +1 unison OSC L/R, Knolle 3rd partial + stereo ≈ 0.75 + 0.45

failure_modes: The signature is inaudible on the target device: the Knolle sits at f0/2–f0/4 (≈ 55–130 Hz) behind LP 400 Hz; phone speakers roll off below ≈ 300–500 Hz (A) and the LP removes the partials that would carry it; the JI pull (±14 cents) is heard only as vanishing beats after ≥ 1–2 s of a held chord → on a phone the engine is a soft Faserton (Nebel/Obertöne family); fine on headphones/iPad.
One finger = a sub-oscillator (Nebel already has `sub`); the organism needs ≥ 2 held notes or a lane → the least distinctive of the four in single-finger play.

[A from the score formula] Arpeggio flicker in Puls: each 0.22-s hit sounds alone, so f0 = f/2 jumps with every step (the old root scores 0 against a non-harmonic new note, the 1.15 hysteresis cannot hold it) → with Trägheit 0.8 s the Knolle glides C→E→G = a seasick bass; needs a harmonic memory (notes stay in the candidate set with weights decaying over 1–2 s), root changes only when the windowed score beats 1.15× the old one, lane hits at half weight.

JI pull on sustained notes: every root flip re-bends all held notes by up to ±35 cents (tc 0.4 s) = audible glissandi on pads; with sus chords, clusters, modal/microtonal scales or N.free the search is noisy → scale Zug by the same confidence (score/Σw)² as the Knolle level; Zug 0 when N.free (V APP 2027).
MIDI/MPE: v.ji sums into the same detune as the bend bus (AudioParam inputs sum, V webaudio.md §7) – fine, but per-note MPE slides plus JI pull fight; pause Zug during glides and while MPE bend ≠ 0.

Singleton bookkeeping: lazy A.knl dies 3 s after the last voice; panic() (APP 8305) and Schlafen must kill it; bus choice (fin vs lane strip) decides whether the mixer can balance it; it never gets stolen, so it must be counted in voiceLoad() by hand.
Scoped to its own engine the Knolle is heard only when every finger plays Knolle; its value is larger engine-agnostic (listen to all held voices) and as an Ebene-2 layer.
fixes: harmonic memory 1–2 s in the root search; windowed hysteresis; lane hits half weight
Zug and Knolle level both ∝ confidence²; Zug 0 for N.free; pause during glides/MPE bends
Knolle LP ≥ 1 kHz with y tilt, partials 1·0.7·0.5·0.3 so it carries on phone speakers; field lamp for the found root
search over all held voices of any engine (engine-agnostic), offer Knolle as the Ebene-2 layer under other engines
own return or 'fin' with a level param; count the singleton in voiceLoad(); kill in panic()/Schlafen
verdict: Selten: adaptive reine Stimmung ist seit 20 Jahren Werkzeug (Hermode in Logic/Cubase, Kontakt Dynamic Pure Tuning, Pivotuner 2023, alt-tuner, Mutabor; Patent US 4248119 mit Akkord-Grundtonerkennung → JI), und ein zuhörender Bass-Grundton ist die Auto-Bass-Chord-Funktion jedes Arranger-Keyboards seit 1985 – neu ist nur die Verbindung als klingender, vertrauensgewichteter Organismus mit Zug auf die Haltetöne; die Stimme selbst (PeriodicWave + Tiefpass + Sub) ist Nebel/Obertöne-Gebiet. Nativ und billig (≈ 0,4 je Stimme + 0,3 Singleton, Suche vernachlässigbar). Musikalisch wackelt die Signatur genau dort, wo Myzel lebt: auf dem Handy-Lautsprecher verschwindet die Knolle (55–130 Hz hinter LP 400 Hz), mit einem Finger ist sie ein Sub-Oszillator, im Puls springt die Grundtonsuche mit jedem Arpeggio-Schlag (ein Ton allein setzt f0 = f/2, die Hysterese greift nicht) → seekranker Bass, und Zug biegt Haltetöne bei jedem Grundtonwechsel um bis zu 35 Cent. Mit harmonischem Gedächtnis (1–2 s abklingende Kandidatenmenge), Zug und Pegel beide ∝ Vertrauen², hellerer Knolle (LP ≥ 1 kHz) und – wichtiger – einer Suche über alle gehaltenen Stimmen statt nur der eigenen Engine wäre sie der Bass, der Myzel zuhört, und als Ebene-2-Schicht wertvoller denn als eigene Klangquelle.
marks: V = source read in this session, VS = WebSearch result summary (page itself blocked by proxy), M = measured (sim/bio_sim.py, sim/bio_sim.out), APP = app code line, A = inference
